name: IchimokuTool
description: Ichimoku Cloud - comprehensive indicator showing trend, momentum, and support/resistance. Price above cloud = bullish, below = bearish. Cloud acts as support/resistance.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT). Use the same symbol that was passed to the market data tool.

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d). Must match the timeframe used when fetching the market data.

fields.label: Conversion Line Period (Tenkan-sen)
fields.description: Period for Tenkan-sen (Conversion Line). Standard is 9. Short-term trend indicator.

fields.label: Base Line Period (Kijun-sen)
fields.description: Period for Kijun-sen (Base Line). Standard is 26. Medium-term trend and support/resistance.

fields.label: Leading Span B Period (Senkou Span B)
fields.description: Period for Senkou Span B (cloud boundary). Standard is 52. Long-term trend indicator.

fields.label: Displacement (Chikou Span)
fields.description: Displacement for Chikou Span (Lagging Span). Standard is 26. Shows momentum confirmation.
